lines.text: Wait! What Causes Sudden Hiccups Inside Your Belly!
Most kids guess totally wrong about what causes hiccups!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
A hiccup is a sudden spasm of the diaphragm muscle under your.
lungs that pulls air in fast and snaps your vocal cords shut.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Hiccup Trick!
